item.title: [7.0] India bonds track Treasury weakness ahead of debt supply
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Indian government bonds are currently facing losses as traders brace for an influx of debt supply and mounting inflation pressures. The 10-year US Treasury yield is nearing the 5% mark, fueled by predictions of the Federal Reserve's interest rate hikes in December. With India's retail inflation climbing to 6.09%, expectations rise for further rate adjustments by the Reserve Bank of India.

WHY IT MATTERS

The convergence of rising domestic inflation at 6.09%, heavy debt supply, and US Treasury yields near 5% signals meaningful macro headwinds for Indian fixed-income markets.

item.description:

item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation (OV-SGG) requires models to recognize visual relationships beyond the training vocabulary, yet existing methods often rely on dataset-specific object--predicate co-occurrence patterns. Under long-tailed distributions and noisy object localization, such reliance leads to biased, entangled relation representations, limiting both rare-relation recognition...

WHY IT MATTERS

The paper introduces a novel framework (RaRe) that leverages MLLM chain-of-thought rationales for structured relation embeddings in open-vocabulary scene graph generation, though it remains a specialized computer vision and multimodal research topic.

item.description:

Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. Existing robotics benchmarks are built around visuomotor policy learning, leaving it open whether coding agents can reliably control diverse robots under physical-world constraints. We therefore introduce the Embodied First Exam, a unified, comprehensive, and agent-native...

This introduces a large-scale, unified evaluation framework for coding agents in robotics, addressing a major gap in assessing agentic control under physical constraints.
